svg.title: Curry On: a practical food day
svg.desc: A starting example around 2100 calories with 110 grams protein, 270 grams carbohydrate, 65 grams fat, and less than 14 grams saturated fat. Separate breakfast, lunch, dinner and snack planning targets.

g.text: CURRY ON / THE FOOD DAY
Familiar meals. A little more intention.
Whole-meal targets, including sides. Ingredients below are flexible starting points.
~2,100 kcal
110 g protein
~270 g carbs
65 g fat
<14 g sat. fat
Planning example, not measured calorie needs. Aim for 30–35 g total fibre, increased gradually.
01 Breakfast
25 g protein · ~65 g carbs · 15 g fat
Oats chilla + plain low-fat Greek yogurt
OR eggs + avocado + wholegrain toast
Give oats and toast a protein partner.
02 Lunch
30 g protein · ~85 g carbs · 20 g fat
Rajma/chole + modest rice + yogurt + veg
OR lower-fat paneer/soy curry + roti
Beans contribute carbs as well as protein.
03 Dinner
35 g protein · ~80 g carbs · 20 g fat
Chicken/fish curry + vegetables + rice/roti
OR dal + tofu/yogurt + vegetables + roti
Meat portions exclude bones and gravy.
04 Snacks
20 g protein · ~40 g carbs · 10 g fat
Whey + fruit; or yogurt + fruit + nuts
Use portions that complement your meals.
Snacks are within the total, not added on top.
Keep the recipe. Measure oil. Change full-fat paneer. Make fibre routine.
Foods are options, not exact macro matches. Use the website’s portions and estimates; adjust with professional advice.
